subject: Unable to deploy shiny app due to unable to retrieve package records

messages.author: d2ade1ae675fc678
messages.subject: Unable to deploy shiny app due to unable to retrieve package records
parts:
Hi

I wrote a shiny app that runs perfectly fine on my local machine, but when I try to deploy it from RStudio, it gives me the following error.

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 198933...Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- "grDevices", "graphics", "grid", "methods", "stats", "tools", "utils"
Execution halted

Usually I would try to look for a solution online but I can't seem to fine any. I have tried redirecting the libPath, copying the base libraries to a new location and pointing libPaths and wd to it, but to no avail.

The problem is that the packages are base packages of R and I am not able to install it from CRAN or github. My sessioninfo is as follows:

messages.subject: Re: Unable to deploy shiny app due to unable to retrieve package records
parts:
Could you create an issue with the rsconnect package: https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect
I would do it for you, but you should get the notifications. :)

Meantime, I think if you set the option "rsconnect.error.trace" you will get a trace that might be helpful.

messages.author: 6dc2a15609bf4c5c
messages.subject: Re: Unable to deploy shiny app due to unable to retrieve package records
parts:
HI Justin,

I too got the same problem today. but when i went over the link "https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/227057448-Are-there-any-limitations-to-the-packages-I-can-use-in-an-app-I-deploy-to-shinyapps-io-" i got to know that shinyapps.io service supports deploying packages installed from CRAN, GitHub (both public and private repos), and BioConductor only. if any of your packages in the app you are trying to build are installed from any other source other than CRAN/GITHUB or BioConductor  the the app will not work. 
I posted issue on the https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies/issues.
 

Thanks
Navene Goud Bobburi
